prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab the object. If visible, approach and take it. Process properties and perform a specific task; else, scan area.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <Action ID = DoSpecificTask    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = MoveForward    /> <Action ID = MoveRight    /> <Action ID = MoveLeft    /> <Action ID = MoveBackward    /> <Action ID = TurnClockwise    /> <Action ID = TurnCounterClockwise    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectReached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObjectProperties    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectReached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDestination
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObjectProperties
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
